meta.name_zh: 癌症登記檔長表LF(2007-2010 年)
meta.data_description_zh:
1. 各醫院自 2007 年起新診斷的癌症個案應全部改採新版癌症登記項目申報。其中 50 床
以上的醫院依短表摘錄手冊規定申報癌症發生和診療摘要資料；另原參與 TCDB 申報
的醫院，則依長表摘錄手冊申報六大癌症(子宮頸癌、乳癌、口腔癌、肺癌、肝癌、結
直腸癌)之發生和診療詳細資料。
2. 自2008診斷年新增攝護腺癌、胃癌、食道癌和膀胱癌，共十大癌症。
3. 自2009診斷年新增鼻咽癌、主唾液腺癌、子宮體癌、卵巢癌和血液腫瘤，共十五大癌
症。
4. AJCC 癌症分期版本於診斷年2007-2009年採用第六版申報，自診斷年2010年起個案，
均採用第七版申報。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 自 2007 年起，癌症登記長表申報均採用 95 欄位；且適用於所有診斷年 2002 至 2010
年個案，故癌症登記長表95欄位資料庫包含部分2002至2006診斷年之個案。
2. 長表醫院所需申報之癌症類型除2007年申報的子宮頸癌、乳癌、結直腸癌、口腔癌、
肺癌、肝癌，及2008 年新增的攝護腺癌、胃癌、食道癌和膀胱癌外，2009年再增加鼻
咽癌、主唾液腺癌、子宮體癌、卵巢癌和血液腫瘤，共15種癌症。
3. AJCC 癌症分期第六版與第七版之間，因部分癌別其 TNM 與期別組合 Stage 在兩個版
本之間有不同，故分析不同診斷年之間的期別分布時，應小心詮釋。
4. 首次復發資料收錄為個案經診斷為癌症後，追蹤滿五年內是否首次發生癌症復發狀態，
僅個案分類 1 與 2 者須追蹤申報該欄位內容。若五年內首次復發後，仍再重複復發，
本欄位僅記錄第一次復發狀態；若超過五年後才發生首次復發，則本欄位登錄為無復
發。有關復發資訊僅於診斷後滿一年與滿五年各申報一次。
5. 死亡日期、死亡原因等欄位，因受限於醫院申報癌登資料之時程，此二欄位較不完整，
若需完整資料，建議申請死因統計檔使用。
6. 本使用手冊係依據臺灣癌症登記中心手冊，詳細內容請至臺灣癌症登記中心網頁下載，
如「96年版台灣癌症登記摘錄手冊」。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分證字號、
院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等欄位均經屏蔽處
理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審核通過之統計結果，以
確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
meta.primary_keys_raw:
1. 身分證字號(ID)經加密處理。
2. 個人歸戶及個人資料對照的鍵值：ID。
meta.name_zh_from_listing: Health14_癌症登記檔長表LF(2010年以前版本)
meta.data_description_en:
1. From 2007, all newly diagnosed cancer cases at each hospital are to be reported using the new cancer registry items. Hospitals with 50 beds
or more report cancer occurrence and treatment summary data as specified in the short-form abstracting manual; hospitals that previously participated in TCDB reporting
report detailed occurrence and treatment data for the six major cancers (cervical, breast, oral, lung, liver, colorec-
tal) according to the long-form abstracting manual.
2. From diagnosis year 2008, prostate, stomach, esophageal and bladder cancers were added, making ten major cancers.
3. From diagnosis year 2009, nasopharyngeal, major salivary gland, uterine corpus and ovarian cancers and hematologic malignancies were added, making fifteen major cancers
.
4. The AJCC cancer staging edition used for reporting is the 6th edition for diagnosis years 2007-2009, and the 7th edition for cases from diagnosis year 2010,
all of which are reported using the 7th edition.
meta.notes_en:
1. From 2007, the cancer registry long form is reported with 95 fields, applicable to all cases of diagnosis years 2002 to 2010,
so the 95-field long-form database includes some cases of diagnosis years 2002 to 2006.
2. Besides the cervical, breast, colorectal, oral,
lung and liver cancers reported in 2007 and the prostate, stomach, esophageal and bladder cancers added in 2008, hospitals reporting the long form added nasopharyngeal,
major salivary gland, uterine corpus and ovarian cancers and hematologic malignancies in 2009, for a total of 15 cancer types.
3. Between the AJCC 6th and 7th editions, the TNM and stage group combinations differ for some cancers,
so the stage distribution should be interpreted with caution when comparing different diagnosis years.
4. First recurrence data record whether a first cancer recurrence occurred within five years of the cancer diagnosis,
and only cases in case classification 1 and 2 must be followed up and report this field. If recurrence repeats after a first recurrence within five years,
this field records only the status of the first recurrence; if the first recurrence occurs after more than five years, this field is coded as no recur-
rence. Recurrence information is reported only twice, once at one year and once at five years after diagnosis.
5. The fields for date of death and cause of death are less complete because of the timing of hospital cancer registry reporting;
if complete data are needed, applying for the cause-of-death statistics file is recommended.
6. This user manual is based on the Taiwan Cancer Registry manual; for details, download it from the Taiwan Cancer Registry website,
for example the "2007 (ROC 96) edition of the Taiwan Cancer Registry Abstracting Manual".
*The database of this Center has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been deleted; any ID numbers,
institution codes, insured unit codes, unified business numbers, dates of birth, dates of care, admission dates and similar fields have all been masked,
and the data can only be used within the independent work area set up by the Ministry, with only statistical results that have passed review taken out, so as to
ensure that the use and disclosure of the data cannot identify any specific individual.
meta.primary_keys_en:
1. Personal ID number (ID) is encrypted.
2. Key for individual linkage and personal-data matching: ID.

meta.data_description_en:

2. Starting with diagnosis year 2008, prostate cancer, gastric cancer, esophageal cancer, and bladder cancer were added, bringing the total to ten major cancers.
3. Starting with diagnosis year 2009, nasopharyngeal cancer, major salivary gland cancer, corpus uteri cancer, ovarian cancer, and hematologic malignancies were added, bringing the total to fifteen major cancers.
4. Cases diagnosed in 2007-2009 were reported using AJCC 6th edition staging; cases diagnosed from 2010 onward have all been reported using AJCC 7th edition staging.
meta.notes_en:
1. From 2007, the cancer registry long form is reported with 95 fields, applicable to all cases of diagnosis years 2002 to 2010,
so the 95-field long-form database includes some cases of diagnosis years 2002 to 2006.
2. Besides the cervical, breast, colorectal, oral
cancers reported in 2007 (cervical, breast, colorectal, oral, lung and liver) and the prostate, stomach, esophageal and bladder cancers added in 2008, in 2009
nasopharyngeal, major salivary gland, uterine corpus and ovarian cancers and hematologic malignancies were added, for a total of 15 cancer types.
3. Between the AJCC 6th and 7th editions, the TNM and stage group combinations differ for some cancers in the two
editions, so the stage distribution should be interpreted with caution when comparing different diagnosis years.
4. First recurrence data record whether a first cancer recurrence occurred within five years of the cancer diagnosis; only cases in case classification 1 and 2 must be followed up

5. The fields for date of death and cause of death are less complete because of the timing of hospital cancer registry reporting;

meta.data_description_zh:
1. 各醫院自 2007 年起新診斷的癌症個案應全部改採新版癌症登記項目申報。其中
50 床以上的醫院依短表摘錄手冊規定申報癌症發生和診療摘要資料；另原參與
TCDB 申報的醫院，則依長表摘錄手冊申報六大癌症(子宮頸癌、乳癌、口腔癌、
肺癌、肝癌、結直腸癌)之發生和診療詳細資料。
2. 自2008診斷年起新增攝護腺癌、胃癌、食道癌和膀胱癌，共十大癌症。
3. 自2009診斷年起新增鼻咽癌、主唾液腺癌、子宮體癌、卵巢癌和血液腫瘤，共
十五大癌症。
4. 自2013診斷年起新增喉癌，共十六大癌症。
5. AJCC 癌症分期版本於診斷年2010年起個案，均採用第七版申報。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 為因應癌症診療實務之需求，國民健康署於民國98年起，開始著手規劃於台灣
癌症登記長表資料庫中增收癌症部位特定因子之資料；同時基於公共衛生的考
量，並將吸菸、嚼檳榔、飲酒、身體及體重之收錄納入100年版癌症登記摘錄
手冊中增修。
2. 長表醫院所需申報之癌症類型除2007年申報的子宮頸癌、乳癌、結直腸癌、口
腔癌、肺癌、肝癌，及2008年新增的攝護腺癌、胃癌、食道癌和膀胱癌外，
2009年再增加鼻咽癌、主唾液腺癌、子宮體癌、卵巢癌和血液腫瘤，2010年擴
大至男、女前10癌(口腔癌、結直腸癌、肝癌、肺癌、乳癌、子宮頸癌、食道
癌、胃癌、攝護腺癌、膀胱癌、主唾液腺癌、鼻咽癌、子宮體癌、卵巢癌及血
液腫瘤等)。
自2013年起再新增喉癌，且部分醫院於2013診斷年起申報全癌長表。
3. 收案對象為中華民國國籍(外籍人士不收案)，第一次經醫師診斷為癌症之個案。
4. 原則上每一癌症個案申報一次，但有另一個原發部位(即多發癌症multiple
primarycancer)需再申報。
5. 2011年1月1日以後新診斷之癌症個案，依100年版台灣癌症登記摘錄手冊申
報。
6. 首次復發資料收錄為個案經診斷為癌症後，追蹤滿五年內是否首次發生癌症復
發狀態，僅個案分類1與2者須追蹤申報該欄位內容。若五年內首次復發後，
仍再重複復發，本欄位僅記錄第一次復發狀態；若超過五年後才發生首次復
發，則本欄位登錄為無復發。有關復發資訊僅於診斷後滿一年與滿五年各申報
一次。
meta.name_zh_from_listing: Health14_癌症登記檔長表LF(2011-2017年版本)
meta.data_description_en:
1. From 2007, all newly diagnosed cancer cases at each hospital are to be reported using the new cancer registry items. Hospitals with
50 or more beds report cancer occurrence and treatment summary data as specified in the short-form abstracting manual; hospitals that previously
participated in TCDB reporting report detailed occurrence and treatment data for the six major cancers (cervical, breast, oral,
lung, liver, colorectal) according to the long-form abstracting manual.
2. From diagnosis year 2008, prostate, stomach, esophageal and bladder cancers were added, making ten major cancers.
3. From diagnosis year 2009, nasopharyngeal, major salivary gland, uterine corpus and ovarian cancers and hematologic malignancies were added, making
fifteen major cancers.
4. From diagnosis year 2013, laryngeal cancer was added, making sixteen major cancers.
5. For cases diagnosed from 2010, the AJCC 7th edition is used for cancer staging in reporting.
meta.notes_en:
1. To meet the needs of clinical cancer care, the Health Promotion Administration began planning, from ROC 98 (2009), to add site-specific factor data to the
Taiwan Cancer Registry long-form database; for public health considerations, smoking, betel-nut chewing, alcohol drinking, height and weight
were also added and revised in the ROC 100 (2011) edition of the cancer registry
abstracting manual.
2. Besides the cervical, breast, colorectal, oral,
lung and liver cancers reported in 2007 and the prostate, stomach, esophageal and bladder cancers added in 2008, the cancer types long-form hospitals must report
were expanded in 2009 to include nasopharyngeal, major salivary gland, uterine corpus and ovarian cancers and hematologic malignancies, and in 2010 were extended
to the top 10 cancers in men and women (oral, colorectal, liver, lung, breast, cervical, esophageal,
stomach, prostate, bladder, major salivary gland, nasopharyngeal, uterine corpus and ovarian cancers and hematologic
malignancies, etc.).
Laryngeal cancer was added from 2013, and some hospitals have reported the all-cancer long form since diagnosis year 2013.
3. Cases registered are those of Republic of China nationality (foreign nationals are not registered) who are diagnosed with cancer by a physician for the first time.
4. In principle each cancer case is reported once, but if there is another primary site (i.e., multiple
primary cancers) it must be reported again.
5. Cancer cases newly diagnosed on or after 1 January 2011 are reported according to the ROC 100 (2011) edition of the Taiwan Cancer Registry
abstracting manual.
6. First recurrence data record whether, within five years of the case's cancer diagnosis, a first cancer
recurrence occurred; only cases in case classification 1 and 2 must be followed up and report this field.
If recurrence repeats after a first recurrence within five years,
this field records only the status of the first recurrence; if the first recurrence occurs after more than five years,
this field is coded as no recurrence. Recurrence information is reported only twice, once at one year and once at five years after diagnosis.

meta.name_zh_from_listing: Health14_癌症登記檔長表LF(2011-2017年版本)(20250624起適用)
meta.data_description_en:
1. From 2007, all newly diagnosed cancer cases at each hospital are to be reported using the new cancer registry items. Hospitals with
50 or more beds report cancer occurrence and treatment summary data as specified in the short-form abstracting manual; hospitals that previously
participated in TCDB reporting report detailed occurrence and treatment data for the six major cancers (cervical, breast, oral,
lung, liver, colorectal) according to the long-form abstracting manual.
2. From diagnosis year 2008, prostate, stomach, esophageal and bladder cancers were added, making ten major cancers.
3. From diagnosis year 2009, nasopharyngeal, major salivary gland, uterine corpus and ovarian cancers and hematologic malignancies were added, making
fifteen major cancers.
4. From diagnosis year 2013, laryngeal cancer was added, making sixteen major cancers.
5. For cases diagnosed from 2010, the AJCC 7th edition is used for cancer staging in reporting.
meta.notes_en:
1. To meet the needs of clinical cancer care, the Health Promotion Administration began planning, from ROC 98 (2009), to add site-specific factor data to the
Taiwan Cancer Registry long-form database; for public health considerations, smoking, betel-nut chewing, alcohol drinking, height and weight
were also added and revised in the ROC 100 (2011) edition of the cancer registry
abstracting manual.
2. Besides the cervical, breast, colorectal, oral,
lung and liver cancers reported in 2007 and the prostate, stomach, esophageal and bladder cancers added in 2008, the cancer types long-form hospitals must report
were expanded in 2009 to include nasopharyngeal, major salivary gland, uterine corpus and ovarian cancers and hematologic malignancies, and in 2010 were extended
to the top 10 cancers in men and women (oral, colorectal, liver, lung, breast, cervical, esophageal,
stomach, prostate, bladder, major salivary gland, nasopharyngeal, uterine corpus and ovarian cancers and hematologic
malignancies, etc.).
Laryngeal cancer was added from 2013, and some hospitals have reported the all-cancer long form since diagnosis year 2013.
3. Cases registered are those of Republic of China nationality (foreign nationals are not registered) who are diagnosed with cancer by a physician for the first time.
4. In principle each cancer case is reported once, but if there is another primary site (i.e., multiple
primary cancers) it must be reported again.
5. Cancer cases newly diagnosed on or after 1 January 2011 are reported according to the ROC 100 (2011) edition of the Taiwan Cancer Registry
abstracting manual.
6. First recurrence data record whether, within five years of the case's cancer diagnosis, a first cancer
recurrence occurred; only cases in case classification 1 and 2 must be followed up and report this field.
If recurrence repeats after a first recurrence within five years,
this field records only the status of the first recurrence; if the first recurrence occurs after more than five years, this field is coded as no recurrence. Recurrence information is reported only twice, once at one year and once at five years after diagnosis.
